alarms.meaning: Same provisional official6345-to-local31196c01 assembly used by all four owned cockpit lessons. Detailed collision regions overlap; cannot simply waive.
evidence: All four exact relative transforms equal matrix[-1,0,0;0,0,1;0,1,0],translation(0,-34,-148) in cockpit coordinates.

Expanded actual meshes produce4 strict crossing events at only two extremely close witness points, separation about0.0008LDU. This is consistent with rounding/near-contact, not enough to certify zero material intersection or real-scale fit.
Local31196c01 is explicitly simplified, not certified CAD; source shows canopy seated on cockpit.

triangleDiagnostic.limitation: Not a watertight solid boolean: zero crossings alone does not exclude containment or coplanar overlap.

alarms.action: No reliable position change justified by sub-millildu numerical crossing; retain alarm until robust tolerance/solid/contact and physical interface evidence.
